108-maidens-of-destiny:
“Your servant is Majestic Star ‘Panther Head’ Lin Chong, from this day forward I am your woman!”
When the beautiful and heroic young girl in front of him shouted those heaven shattering words, Su Xing was overwhelmed with shock.
And so the tale of the 108 maidens of destiny from legends begins.
In Liangshan Continent, a genius is defined as a Star Master who is capable of signing the Star Duel Covenant contract with two Star Maidens. This was truly the limit.
But right now Su Xing’s dilemma is how to convince the “Strength Star” Lu Junyi to become his eighth Star Knight. And this is just the beginning…
—
This novel is based on the ancient Chinese classic Water Margin or Outlaws of the Marsh. 108 beautiful maidens with earth shattering power is unleashed into the Liangshan Continent every 108 years. Our hero, a military pilot, ripped through space and time while test flying a new fighter jet and ended up in this world.
boss-mos-predestined-love-brought-by-sur: The poor aristocrat Viola suddenly received an unexpected marriage proposal from the prestigious noble household of Duke Physalis. An average noble daughter and the handsome duke. She had been confused, thinking that nothing made sense, but the duke had his own personal reasons. building-a-harem-in-a-noble-house:
What do you do when you can't beat the Demon Lord on your own?
Go back in time and build a harem, of course!
Well, that wasn't the goal. Lloyd May's actual goal was to build a powerful Noble House alongside his childhood friend and surrogate sister Lyra Knight. They'd buy the crumbling House Greaves, turn it into House May, then recruit a bunch of powerful adventurers to join them in their fight against the Demon Lord!
But it could never be that simple, could it?
A demanding daughter of House Greaves, a lonely paladin and her weird magical pet cat, a retired magic tutor, and a haughty dark mage… and all of their strange demands.
As long as it leads to the Demon Lord’s death, Lloyd May will do anything.
chaos-and-order-a-multiverse-fanfic:
Bred to be humanity’s Messiah. Betrayed into becoming its greatest Demon. Kai Stormborn died after exacting revenge.
But death could not claim him.
Reborn in the Primordial Tower. A battleground where Chaos and Order wage war. And Kai? He is neither. He is something far worse, carrying a Glitch — a forbidden anomaly that lets him devour magical creatures, assimilate their abilities, and evolve.
To ascend beyond mortality, Kai must consume worlds, crush their champions, and rewrite their fates.
He bends the Harry Potter timeline to his will. He manipulates the Great Houses of Game of Thrones like pawns. He fuses the very realities of Demon Slayer, Bleach, and more into his domain. His Breathing Style warps the laws of Reality Marbles. His mind becomes an Artificial Intelligence. His spirit wields the Will of D.
Dumbledore fears him. The Akatsuki hunt him. The Gotei 13, the Warlords, the Jedi—all have stood in his way. All have fallen.
Kai no longer walks as a mere Contestant—he is ascending into something Eldritch.
Corpses stack like monuments in his wake and Timelines fracture as he upends the lores of the worlds. He does not follow Chaos. He does not obey Order.…

Augustus Cross was a man close to his 30s with nothing to his name. People rolled their eyes at the seemingly useless man and he remained helpless even as his daughter was at the brink of death.
When all hope seemed lost, the hidden dragon within him was unleashed when the seal broke accidentally as his birthmark was stained with his own blood. Knowledge of ancient arts filled his subconscious, granting him powers to cure his daughter and other incurable illnesses.
A man who was once looked down by everyone is unstoppable now. What lies beyond this man with the power he now possesses?
fantasy-football: In a gritty world where fallen football clubs struggle to rise again, Mystic Dark inherits more than just a name—he awakens a hidden system tied to his bloodline, one that grants him the tools to rebuild his family’s shattered legacy. With a bubbling AI assistant, access to magical currencies, and a mysterious past life’s knowledge of overlooked talents, Mystic sets out not as a player, but as a coach determined to revive the Dark Elites, with knowledge from his past life. Fantasy meets football in a high-stakes race against time, corruption, and forgotten dreams.---This is just me trying to write about the boys (my friends) I watched play ball—so much raw talent, yet where I come from, it’s hard to get the recognition they deserve. So I’m using this medium to tell their stories, based on everything I’ve witnessed, shaped by my erratic mind, with a touch of fiction, a storyline that never existed but I created—and most importantly, a dash of fantasy. I’m adding magic to soccer. I hope it all comes together and that everyone who reads this enjoys the journey.
flowers-bloom-from-battlefield:
Throughout the Ming Kingdom, Jun Hua was famous for being a useless girl without any talent worthy of praise. Everyone mocked her, belittling her for latching onto her brilliant brother Jun Min, the young and peerless general admired as the most talented prodigy for his talent and his ability to change the fate of the declining Jun Family.
Never in their wildest dreams would they have suspected that Jun Hua is the young general who is leading the army on the frontline, Jun Min!
“She has no talent as a girl, but has the brilliance of a great general!”
Her journey towards revenge is something she has to do on her own. And yet, on that path she will gain allies, friends, and possibly even...... a romance?
This is Jun Hua's story, a story that shall be carved into history as the legend of “the flower who blooms from the battlefields”.
grievance-log-ntr-system:
Chance Brooks is fed up with giving his all and getting nothing in return.
All his life, people, friends, strangers, even those he barely knew, have taken advantage of him. He always believed that if he did the right thing, if he kept giving and kept helping, eventually it would pay off.
He was wrong.
Bu after that night, everything changes. Chance awakens to a system unlike anything he could have imagined, a system that gives him the power to finally change his life.
No more giving. No more being used. No more expecting something in return.
This time, Chance is taking. And he has no intention of giving anything back.

He found that the System not only sent him on deadly explorations in forbidden places but also recorded all his near-death experiences as video material, and later even threw Lu Ban into the Indescribable Another World!

Hasami Tatsuro obtained the “Level Eater” skill. “Level Eater” allowed the host to devour others’ levels/skills and make it his own.

Every family has that one person who is born as a sacrifice. For her family, that person was Selene Vale, who was to become a spare for her younger twin siblings success.
Due to her innate shy and kind nature, she was not able to connect to her family every since she was young. So, despite her rich background, Selene Vale never felt like a part of the family and was often regarded as the 'First spare' or even 'defective'. That did not change even when the world fell and Apocalypses happened.
Selene Vale's first life ended trying to protect her twin siblings, the only people who had yet to abandon her. That was her end...
...but it wasn't.
Due to her sacrifice, Selene Vale awakened her system and innate power and was given another chance at life and survival. And this time, she vowed to free her siblings from their parent's cruel influence. If she was able to do that, then she would be happy with that.
But unfortunately, that was not all she did. She also ended up attracting the attention of the big-boss of the Apocalypse, the only L-ranked hunter and the hope of humanity....and also, a long time friend she would rather forget about.

treasure-hunt-tycoons-priceless-runaway-:
New story “99 Pursuits: Young Master Ning, Can't Stop Pampering” has been released, absolutely sweet and indulgent!
Rumor has it that a certain CEO is not fond of women, yet his five-year-old son keeps clamoring for a mommy, while all the women who come forward get repeatedly rejected.
“The legs are too thick, the chest is too small, the waist not slim enough!” the cute child shakes his head in disapproval.
The women lament: Is he looking for a mommy or a wife?!
The man nods in satisfaction: As expected of his son, warding off many unsuitable romances.
Until one day, the cute child brings a beauty to him and says: I've taken a liking to this woman! If you don't marry her, I will!
The man sneers coldly, thinking this woman is audacious, trying to deceive his son to marry into a wealthy family?
Fine! The man straightforwardly throws a check and contract in the woman's face: Be my woman!
Le Tong is dumbfounded, then outraged, packs up her things, and runs away, not forgetting to hand in her resignation letter.
“CEO, the service that night was not bad, this is your tip!” Ji Rui looks at the penny in front of him, his face dark with anger: Chase after her!
twins-reunite-bringing-mom-and-dad-toget:
Seven years ago, Eleanor Sterling was framed and humiliated by her treacherous sister, resulting in the birth of a child with an unknown father.
Seven years later, she returns with her adorable child and numerous disguises to seek revenge and sweep away all wicked foes.
However, she unexpectedly finds herself entangled with two persistent individuals.
Little Sticky Bun: “Mommy, it's buy one, get one free!”
Big Sticky Bun traps her in his embrace, gritting his teeth: “Hacked my account?”
Eleanor Sterling: “Alaric, let me explain.”
The man then brings out the two children, “Stole my genes?”
Eleanor grits her teeth; the man who ruined her reputation years ago was him?
Alaric Faulkner carries her to bed, “One stolen, punished tenfold, give me another to compensate!”
wonderful-insane-world:
In a world ravaged by radiation and the remnants of war, Dylan is far from a classic hero. A lieutenant with a tainted past, he's just trying to survive the ruins of a dying world... until the day he wakes up bound and surrounded by the mutilated corpses of his comrades.
Captured by monstrous creatures, he soon realizes he’s been transported to another world. A world far more dangerous, far more brutal—where only the strong survive, and even monsters are hunted. Saved in extremis by Maggie, his commanding officer, he begins a desperate escape. Their only hope may lie in their encounter with Élisa, an elf abandoned by her kin, and their discovery of a mysterious power: anima gems—stones imbued with spiritual essence that can enhance body and soul, and unlock the path to awakening.
